label: MAINT-V82-HERMETIC-ENTRY
title: Make p6-maint-v82 runnable from a clean worktree
model_selection: spawn_agent model omitted; user-confirmed default gpt-5.6-luna[max]
reproduction: clean worktree make p6-maint-v82 first fails creating build/difftest/hard_maint_v82.bin
after manually creating build/difftest it fails because qemu/plugins/lcvex_difftest.so is absent
scope: Make the existing p6-maint-v82 target declare/create only its real local prerequisites so a clean worktree reaches the six lockstep windows. Do not change the maintenance programs, reference results, protocol, RTL, or QEMU source.
acceptance: make -n p6-maint-v82 shows directory and plugin preparation before execution
actual clean-worktree execution is deferred to the single heavy queue and may expose the separately tracked T-20260905-005 RTL failure
integration: Cherry-pick after read-only review onto the Round16 candidate; the merged SHA full p6-maint-v82 run is final evidence.
board_policy: No JTAG programming, bitstream assembly, power-on, or board test without explicit user permission.
